#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Download one batch51 native CI artifact; unpack only named evidence files.

Repository credentials remain in memory and are sent only to the exact GitHub
artifact API. Redirect targets are fetched without Authorization. Whole trees
are never extracted: hostile and POSIX-only filenames remain inside archives.
"""
from __future__ import annotations
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
import stat
import subprocess
import sys
import tarfile
import urllib.error
import urllib.parse
import urllib.request
import zipfile

sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
REPOSITORY_ID = 1467240913
NESTED = ("selfhost-driver", "selfhost-digest", "selfhost-diagnostics", "selfhost-errors",
          "selfhost-sanitizers", "system-sanitize", "test-summary", "csv-check", "dep-index")
DIRECT = {
    "results.json": "results.json",
    "tests-debug.log": "tests-debug.log",
    "tests-release.log": "tests-release.log",
    "selfhost/receipt.json": "bootstrap-receipt.json",
}


def require(condition, message):
    if not condition:
        raise ValueError(message)


def safe_member_name(name, prefix=None):
    # Backslash/control characters are legitimate POSIX evidence filenames.
    # Check both separator interpretations, then keep every tree unextracted.
    require(isinstance(name, str) and name and "\0" not in name, "invalid archive member name")
    portable = name.replace("\\", "/").rstrip("/")
    parts = portable.split("/")
    require(not portable.startswith("/") and all(part not in ("", ".", "..") for part in parts),
            "archive member has an absolute or traversal path")
    require(not any(re.match(r"^[A-Za-z]:", part) for part in parts), "archive member contains a drive path")
    if prefix is not None:
        require(parts[0] == prefix, "archive member escapes its declared prefix")
    return portable


def validate_zip_members(archive):
    infos = archive.infolist()
    names = [item.filename for item in infos]
    require(len(names) == len(set(names)), "duplicate ZIP members")
    for item in infos:
        safe_member_name(item.filename)
        kind = stat.S_IFMT(item.external_attr >> 16)
        require(kind in (0, stat.S_IFREG, stat.S_IFDIR), "unsupported special ZIP member")
        require(not item.flag_bits & 1, "encrypted ZIP member is not accepted")
    return {"members": len(infos), "tree_extracted": False}


def validate_tar_members(archive, prefix):
    members = archive.getmembers()
    names = [member.name for member in members]
    require(len(names) == len(set(names)), "duplicate TAR members")
    by_name = {member.name: member for member in members}
    links = 0
    for member in members:
        safe_member_name(member.name, prefix)
        require(member.isfile() or member.isdir() or member.islnk(), "unsupported special TAR member")
        if member.islnk():
            # The existing driver corpus deliberately includes hardlink guards.
            safe_member_name(member.linkname, prefix)
            require(member.linkname in by_name and by_name[member.linkname].isfile(),
                    "TAR hardlink does not name an internal regular file")
            links += 1
    return {"members": len(members), "internal_hardlinks": links, "tree_extracted": False}


def identity(name, data):
    return {"name": name, "bytes": len(data), "sha256": hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()}


def unpack_selected(archive_path, output):
    selected, safety = [], {}
    with zipfile.ZipFile(archive_path) as archive:
        safety["zip"] = validate_zip_members(archive)
        names = set(archive.namelist())
        for member, local in DIRECT.items():
            if member in names:
                require(not archive.getinfo(member).is_dir(), "requested ZIP evidence is a directory")
                data = archive.read(member)
                (output / local).write_bytes(data)
                selected.append(identity(member, data))
        for prefix in NESTED:
            name = prefix + ".tar.gz"
            if name not in names:
                continue
            require(not archive.getinfo(name).is_dir(), "requested nested archive is a directory")
            data = archive.read(name)
            local = output / name
            local.write_bytes(data)
            selected.append(identity(name, data))
            with tarfile.open(local, "r:gz") as nested:
                safety[name] = validate_tar_members(nested, prefix)
                receipt_name = prefix + "/receipt.json"
                if receipt_name in nested.getnames():
                    member = nested.getmember(receipt_name)
                    require(member.isfile(), "nested root receipt is not a regular file")
                    raw = nested.extractfile(member).read()
                    (output / (prefix + "-receipt.json")).write_bytes(raw)
                    selected.append(identity(name + ":" + receipt_name, raw))
        (output / "members.json").write_text(json.dumps(sorted(names), ensure_ascii=True, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    return selected, safety


class NoRedirect(urllib.request.HTTPRedirectHandler):
    def redirect_request(self, *args, **kwargs):
        return None


def artifact_response(url):
    # Never expose helper stdout/stderr, bearer headers, or signed redirect URLs.
    credential = subprocess.run(
        ["git", "credential", "fill"],
        input="protocol=https\nhost=github.com\npath=msly/yavo.git\n\n",
        text=True, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
        env={**os.environ, "GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT": "0"}, timeout=15,
    )
    fields = dict(line.split("=", 1) for line in credential.stdout.splitlines() if "=" in line)
    require(credential.returncode == 0 and fields.get("password"), "Repository credential unavailable")
    request = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={
        "Accept": "application/vnd.github+json", "User-Agent": "Yavo-validation",
        "Authorization": "Bearer " + fields["password"],
    })
    try:
        return urllib.request.build_opener(NoRedirect()).open(request, timeout=30)
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as error:
        if error.code not in (301, 302, 303, 307, 308):
            raise RuntimeError("Artifact API returned HTTP " + str(error.code)) from None
        target = error.headers.get("Location", "")
        location = urllib.parse.urlsplit(target)
        require(location.scheme == "https" and location.hostname and not location.username and not location.password,
                "Artifact API redirect was not a valid HTTPS location")
        # Fresh request and opener carry no repository credential.
        try:
            return urllib.request.urlopen(urllib.request.Request(target, headers={
                "User-Agent": "Yavo-validation"}), timeout=30)
        except Exception:
            raise RuntimeError("Signed artifact transfer failed; URL redacted") from None
    except Exception:
        raise RuntimeError("Artifact API request failed; credential and URL redacted") from None

    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--inventory", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--id", type=int, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--run-id", type=int, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--head", required=True, help="Full implementation commit SHA of the selected CI run")
    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    require(re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{40}", args.head), "expected head must be a full lowercase commit SHA")
    inventory_raw = args.inventory.read_bytes()
    inventory = json.loads(inventory_raw)
    matches = [item for item in inventory["artifacts"] if item["id"] == args.id]
    require(len(matches) == 1, "artifact ID missing or duplicated in inventory")
    artifact = matches[0]
    run = artifact["workflow_run"]
    require(run["id"] == args.run_id and run["head_sha"] == args.head and run["head_branch"] == "main",
            "artifact run/head/branch differs from requested producer")
    require(run["repository_id"] == run["head_repository_id"] == REPOSITORY_ID, "artifact repository differs")
    require(artifact["name"] in {"native-" + runner + "-" + args.head for runner in
                               ("ubuntu-24.04", "macos-15", "windows-2025")}, "artifact name is not a native platform producer")
    api = "https://api.github.com/repos/msly/yavo/actions/artifacts/" + str(args.id)
    require(artifact["url"] == api and artifact["archive_download_url"] == api + "/zip",
            "artifact API URL ownership differs")
    require(artifact.get("expired") is False and isinstance(artifact["size_in_bytes"], int)
            and artifact["size_in_bytes"] > 0 and re.fullmatch(r"sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}", artifact["digest"]),
            "artifact size/digest/expiry metadata is invalid")
    out = args.output.resolve()
    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    require(not any(out.iterdir()), "artifact output directory must be empty")
    archive_path = out / "artifact.zip"
    temporary = out / "artifact.zip.part"
    digest, size = hashlib.sha256(), 0
    response = artifact_response(artifact["archive_download_url"])
    try:
        with response, temporary.open("wb") as stream:
            while data := response.read(1024 * 1024):
                size += len(data)
                require(size <= artifact["size_in_bytes"], "artifact transfer exceeded declared size")
                stream.write(data)
                digest.update(data)
    except Exception:
        raise RuntimeError("Artifact transfer failed; any signed URL is redacted") from None
    require(size == artifact["size_in_bytes"], "artifact byte count differs from inventory")
    require("sha256:" + digest.hexdigest() == artifact["digest"], "artifact SHA256 differs from GitHub")
    temporary.replace(archive_path)
    selected, safety = unpack_selected(archive_path, out)
    receipt = {"schema": "yavo-batch51-ci-download/1", "artifact": artifact,
               "requested_run_id": args.run_id, "requested_head": args.head,
               "inventory_sha256": hashlib.sha256(inventory_raw).hexdigest(),
               "downloaded_bytes": size, "sha256": digest.hexdigest(),
               "selected_members": selected, "archive_safety": safety}
    (out / "download-receipt.json").write_text(json.dumps(receipt, ensure_ascii=True, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    print(json.dumps({"artifact_id": args.id, "run_id": args.run_id, "head": args.head,
                      "bytes": size, "sha256": digest.hexdigest(), "selected_members": selected}, ensure_ascii=True, indent=2))
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    try:
        raise SystemExit(main())
    except Exception as error:
        # Validation failures contain no credential; network errors were redacted above.
        print(type(error).__name__ + ": " + str(error), file=sys.stderr)
        raise SystemExit(1)

class InvalidEvidence(ValueError):
    pass


def require(condition, message):
    if not condition:
        raise InvalidEvidence(message)


def sha(data):
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()


def digest(path):
    state = hashlib.sha256()
    with Path(path).open("rb") as source:
        for block in iter(lambda: source.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
            state.update(block)
    return state.hexdigest()


def norm(path):
    return str(path).replace("\\", "/").rstrip("/")


def literal_assignment(path, wanted):
    for node in ast.parse(Path(path).read_text(encoding="utf-8")).body:
        if isinstance(node, ast.Assign) and any(isinstance(t, ast.Name) and t.id == wanted for t in node.targets):
            return ast.literal_eval(node.value)
    raise InvalidEvidence("missing literal assignment " + wanted)


def passed_command(record, code=0):
    return (record.get("exit_code") == code and not record.get("timed_out")
            and not record.get("launch_error"))


def checks_passed(rows, expected=None):
    require(isinstance(rows, list), "missing check inventory")
    ids = [row["id"] for row in rows]
    require(len(ids) == len(set(ids)), "duplicate check IDs")
    if expected is not None:
        require(set(ids) == expected, "check inventory mismatch: " + repr(set(ids) ^ expected))
    require(all(row.get("passed") is True for row in rows), "a required check did not pass")


def current_identity(relative):
    path = ROOT / relative
    return {"path": relative, "bytes": path.stat().st_size, "sha256": digest(path)}


def require_bound(bound, relative):
    suffix = "/" + norm(relative)
    matches = [(path, value) for path, value in bound.items() if norm(path).endswith(suffix)]
    require(matches, "receipt did not bind " + relative)
    wanted = digest(ROOT / relative)
    require(all(value == wanted for _, value in matches), "bound current source mismatch: " + relative)
    return wanted


def fixture_options(case):
    delta = case.get("environment", {})
    require(isinstance(delta, dict), "fixture environment is not an object")
    require(all(key in ("name", "PATH") and
                (value is None or (isinstance(value, str) and "\0" not in value))
                for key, value in delta.items()), "fixture environment exceeds its narrow contract")
    require("isolated_cwd" not in case or type(case["isolated_cwd"]) is bool,
            "fixture cwd isolation is not boolean")
    if "environment" in case or "isolated_cwd" in case:
        require(case.get("kind") in ("run", "panic"), "nonexecutable fixture has execution options")
    return delta, case.get("isolated_cwd", False)


def exact_program_output(case, code, stdout, stderr):
    expected_code = 101 if case["kind"] == "panic" else 0
    require(code == expected_code and stdout == case["stdout"].encode("utf-8"),
            "raw fixture exit/stdout differs from the manifest")
    if case["kind"] == "panic":
        marker = re.search(rb"yavo panic \[(P-[A-Z-]+)\]", stderr)
        require(marker is not None and marker[1].decode() == case["panic"],
                "raw fixture panic category differs from the manifest")
    else:
        require(stderr == case.get("stderr", "").encode("utf-8"),
                "raw fixture stderr differs from the manifest")


def verify_fixture_execution_isolation(archive, boot, manifest):
    rows = {row["id"]: row for row in boot["cases"]}
    controlled, executions, isolated_paths = [], 0, set()
    for case in manifest:
        delta, isolated = fixture_options(case)
        if "environment" not in case and not isolated:
            continue
        controlled.append(case["id"])
        row = rows[case["id"]]
        modes = row["modes"]
        require(len(modes) == 2 and {item["mode"] for item in modes} == {"debug", "release"},
                "controlled fixture lacks both build modes")
        for mode in modes:
            require(mode["passed"] is True, "controlled fixture mode failed")
            for producer in ("reference", "candidate"):
                build = mode[producer + "_build"]
                record = mode[producer + "_run"]
                require(passed_command(build) and "fixture_environment" not in build,
                        "fixture environment altered a build command")
                require(not record.get("timed_out") and not record.get("launch_error"),
                        "controlled fixture did not execute")
                if "environment" in case:
                    require(record.get("fixture_environment") == delta,
                            "bootstrap command environment delta differs from frozen manifest")
                    if "PATH" in delta:
                        require(record["environment"].get("PATH") == delta["PATH"],
                                "bootstrap command effective PATH differs from fixture delta")
                else:
                    require("fixture_environment" not in record,
                            "bootstrap added an undeclared fixture environment")
                require(record["environment"].get("YAVO_ALLOC_CHECK") == "1",
                        "controlled fixture disabled allocation checking")
                suffix = ".exe" if archive.platform == "windows" else ""
                program_directory = norm(boot["work"]) + "/programs/" + case["id"]
                executable = program_directory + "/" + producer + "-" + mode["mode"] + suffix
                require([norm(value) for value in record["argv"]] == [executable],
                        "controlled fixture executed a different binary")
                actual = archive.identity_of(archive.member_from_work("selfhost", boot, executable))
                require(actual["sha256"] == mode[producer + "_sha256"],
                        "controlled fixture binary differs from the recorded build")
                if isolated:
                    wanted_cwd = program_directory + "/" + producer + "-" + mode["mode"] + "-cwd"
                    require(norm(record["cwd"]) == wanted_cwd and wanted_cwd not in isolated_paths,
                            "controlled fixture reused a cwd or ran outside its fresh directory")
                    isolated_paths.add(wanted_cwd)
                label = case["id"] + "-" + mode["mode"] + "-" + producer + "-run"
                command_directory = norm(boot["work"]) + "/commands/" + label
                raw_record = json.loads(archive.read(archive.member_from_work(
                    "selfhost", boot, command_directory + "/command.json")))
                require(raw_record == record, "controlled fixture embedded/raw command receipts differ")
                streams = {}
                for stream in ("stdout", "stderr"):
                    member = archive.member_from_work("selfhost", boot, command_directory + "/" + stream)
                    data = archive.read(member)
                    identity = archive.identity_of(member)
                    require(identity["sha256"] == record[stream]["sha256"]
                            and identity["bytes"] == record[stream]["bytes"]
                            and data == base64.b64decode(record[stream]["base64"], validate=True),
                            "controlled fixture raw stream differs from its receipt")
                    streams[stream] = data
                exact_program_output(case, record["exit_code"], streams["stdout"], streams["stderr"])
                executions += 1
    return {"status": "passed", "cases": len(controlled), "case_ids": controlled,
            "executions": executions, "distinct_isolated_cwds": len(isolated_paths),
            "raw_streams_verified": True, "build_environments_unchanged": True}


class Archive:
    def __init__(self, directory, platform, expected_head):
        self.directory = Path(directory).resolve()
        self.platform = platform
        self.stack = ExitStack()
        self.verified = {}
        self.tars = {}
        self.tar_identities = {}
        self.member_cache = {}
        self.member_cache_bytes = 0
        self.report = json.loads((self.directory / "download-receipt.json").read_bytes())
        require(self.report.get("schema") == "yavo-batch51-ci-download/1", "not a batch51 download receipt")
        meta = self.report["artifact"]
        run = meta["workflow_run"]
        require(run["head_sha"] == expected_head, "artifact belongs to a different head")
        require(run["head_branch"] == "main", "artifact is not from main")
        require(run["repository_id"] == run["head_repository_id"] == 1467240913,
                "artifact repository identity differs from msly/yavo")
        require(meta["name"] == "native-" + PLATFORMS[platform]["runner"] + "-" + expected_head,
                "artifact platform/name mismatch")
        require(meta["url"] == "https://api.github.com/repos/msly/yavo/actions/artifacts/" + str(meta["id"]),
                "artifact API ownership URL mismatch")
        require(meta["archive_download_url"] == meta["url"] + "/zip", "artifact download API ownership differs")
        require(self.report.get("requested_run_id") == run["id"]
                and self.report.get("requested_head") == expected_head, "download producer constraint differs")
        archive = self.directory / "artifact.zip"
        size, actual = archive.stat().st_size, digest(archive)
        require(size == meta["size_in_bytes"] == self.report["downloaded_bytes"], "whole ZIP size mismatch")
        require("sha256:" + actual == meta["digest"] and actual == self.report["sha256"], "whole ZIP SHA256 mismatch")
        self.zip = self.stack.enter_context(zipfile.ZipFile(archive))
        self.archive_safety = {"zip": validate_zip_members(self.zip)}
        names = self.zip.namelist()
        require(len(names) == len(set(names)), "duplicate ZIP members")
        selected = self.report["selected_members"]
        self.selected = {item["name"]: item for item in selected}
        require(len(self.selected) == len(selected), "duplicate download member records")
        self.identity = {
            "id": meta["id"], "name": meta["name"], "run_id": run["id"], "head_sha": run["head_sha"],
            "zip_bytes": size, "zip_sha256": actual, "github_digest_verified": True,
            "download_receipt_sha256": digest(self.directory / "download-receipt.json"),
            "archive_safety": self.archive_safety,
        }

    def close(self):
        self.stack.close()

    def open_tar(self, outer):
        if outer in self.tars:
            return
        # Hash members in archive order once. Gzip random seeks otherwise repeat
        # decompression for every binary, source and log read in receipt order.
        # The cache is memory-only, individually bounded, and never extracts a tree.
        self.local(outer, outer)
        nested = self.stack.enter_context(tarfile.open(self.directory / outer, "r:gz"))
        self.tars[outer] = nested
        self.archive_safety[outer] = validate_tar_members(nested, outer.removesuffix(".tar.gz"))
        for member in nested.getmembers():
            if not member.isfile():
                continue
            spec = outer + ":" + member.name
            state, size, pieces = hashlib.sha256(), 0, []
            cache = member.size <= 262144 and self.member_cache_bytes + member.size <= 134217728
            with nested.extractfile(member) as stream:
                for data in iter(lambda: stream.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
                    state.update(data)
                    size += len(data)
                    if cache:
                        pieces.append(data)
            require(size == member.size, "TAR member size differs from header: " + spec)
            self.tar_identities[spec] = {"member": spec, "bytes": size, "sha256": state.hexdigest()}
            if cache:
                self.member_cache[spec] = b"".join(pieces)
                self.member_cache_bytes += size

    def read(self, spec):
        if ":" in spec:
            outer, inner = spec.split(":", 1)
            self.open_tar(outer)
            if spec in self.member_cache:
                return self.member_cache[spec]
            member = self.tars[outer].getmember(inner)
            require(member.isfile(), "requested TAR member is not a regular file: " + spec)
            stream = self.tars[outer].extractfile(member)
            require(stream is not None, "unreadable TAR member: " + spec)
            data = stream.read()
        else:
            data = self.zip.read(spec)
        return data

    def identity_of(self, spec):
        if ":" in spec:
            self.open_tar(spec.split(":", 1)[0])
        if spec in self.tar_identities:
            value = dict(self.tar_identities[spec])
        else:
            data = self.read(spec)
            value = {"member": spec, "bytes": len(data), "sha256": sha(data)}
        self.verified[spec] = value
        return value

    def local(self, name, spec):
        require(spec in self.selected, "download receipt omitted selected member " + spec)
        data = self.read(spec)
        expected = self.selected[spec]
        require(len(data) == expected["bytes"] and sha(data) == expected["sha256"],
                "download selected-member identity mismatch: " + spec)
        local = self.directory / name
        require(local.read_bytes() == data, "downloaded local file differs from archive member: " + name)
        self.verified[spec] = {"member": spec, "bytes": len(data), "sha256": sha(data), "file": str(local)}
        return data

    def json(self, local, spec):
        return json.loads(self.local(local, spec))

    def member_from_work(self, prefix, report, full_path):
        portable = norm if self.platform == "windows" else lambda value: str(value).rstrip("/")
        work = portable(report["work"])
        path = portable(full_path)
        require(path.startswith(work + "/"), "artifact path escapes recorded work directory")
        leaf = work.rsplit("/", 1)[-1]
        safe_member_name(path[len(work) + 1:])
        if prefix == "selfhost":
            return prefix + "/" + leaf + "/" + path[len(work) + 1:]
        return prefix + ".tar.gz:" + prefix + "/" + leaf + "/" + path[len(work) + 1:]


def verify_native(archive, native, expected_head, platform):
    require(native["schema"] == "yavo-ci/1" and native["status"] == "passed", "native Rust gate not passed")
    require(native["revision"] == expected_head, "native receipt revision mismatch")
    require(native["host"]["machine"].lower() in PLATFORMS[platform]["arch"], "native host architecture mismatch")
    require(native["toolchain_lock_sha256"] == digest(ROOT / "compiler/toolchain.lock"), "native lock changed")
    require(native["cargo_lock_sha256"] == digest(ROOT / "compiler/Cargo.lock"), "Cargo lock changed")
    require(set(native["suites"]) == {"debug", "release"}, "native suite inventory mismatch")
    require(all(passed_command(row) for row in native["commands"]), "native setup/test command failed")
    selected = literal_assignment(ROOT / "tools/ci/run.py", "NATIVE_TESTS")
    wanted_selection = [] if platform == "linux" else ["--bin", "yavo"] + [
        arg for test in selected for arg in ("--test", test)]
    result = {"scope": "full" if platform == "linux" else "selected-native",
              "scope_description": native["scope"], "host": native["host"], "suites": {}}
    for mode in ("debug", "release"):
        suite = native["suites"][mode]
        require(suite["passed"] is True and suite["exit_code"] == 0, "Rust " + mode + " suite failed")
        require(suite["selection"] == wanted_selection, "Rust test selection differs from declared scope")
        log_bytes = archive.local("tests-" + mode + ".log", "tests-" + mode + ".log")
        log = log_bytes.decode("utf-8", "replace")
        matches = [tuple(map(int, match)) for match in CARGO_SUMMARY.findall(log)]
        require(matches, "Rust log has no test summaries")
        totals = dict(zip(("passed", "failed", "ignored", "measured", "filtered_out"),
                          [sum(values) for values in zip(*matches)]))
        require(totals == suite["totals"], "Rust reported totals differ from downloaded log")
        require(totals["passed"] > 0 and totals["failed"] == 0 and totals["ignored"] == 1
                and totals["filtered_out"] == 0, "Rust totals violate the native gate")
        item = {"totals": totals, "groups": len(matches), "selection": suite["selection"],
                "log_sha256": sha(log_bytes)}
        if platform == "linux":
            conformance = suite["conformance"]
            require(conformance["passed"] is True and conformance["counts"] ==
                    {"pass": 124, "unsupported": 3, "superseded": 2}, "frozen conformance mismatch")
            item["frozen_conformance"] = conformance["counts"]
        else:
            require("conformance" not in suite, "selected native suite falsely reports full conformance")
        result["suites"][mode] = item
    return result

def artifact_file(archive, prefix, scope, record, *, return_bytes=True):
    member = archive.member_from_work(prefix, scope, record["path"])
    actual = archive.identity_of(member)
    require(actual["sha256"] == record["sha256"]
            and ("bytes" not in record or actual["bytes"] == record["bytes"]),
            "archived artifact differs from its receipt: " + member)
    return archive.read(member) if return_bytes else None


def stream_bytes(archive, prefix, scope, record):
    if "base64" in record:
        raw = base64.b64decode(record["base64"], validate=True)
        require(len(raw) == record["bytes"] and sha(raw) == record["sha256"], "inline stream identity mismatch")
        return raw
    return artifact_file(archive, prefix, scope, record)

    for field, name in (("contract", "CONTRACT.md"), ("oracle", "oracle.py"), ("cases", "io-cases.json")):

    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("batch51_archived_error_oracle", directory / "oracle.py")

    spec.loader.exec_module(oracle)

    host = PLATFORMS[platform]["python"]

            and set(excluded) == ({"stdin_read_error", "env_invalid_utf8"} if platform == "windows" else set()),

def error_command(archive, report, command, *, code=0, check_code=True):
    stdout = artifact_file(archive, "selfhost-errors", report, command["stdout"])
    stderr = artifact_file(archive, "selfhost-errors", report, command["stderr"])
    directory = norm(command["stdout"]["path"]).rsplit("/", 1)[0]
    require(norm(command["stdout"]["path"]) == directory + "/stdout.bin"
            and norm(command["stderr"]["path"]) == directory + "/stderr.bin", "error gate command streams have different roots")
    member = archive.member_from_work("selfhost-errors", report, directory + "/command.json")
    require(json.loads(archive.read(member)) == command, "raw error gate command differs from receipt")
    archive.identity_of(member)
    require(not command["timed_out"] and not command["launch_error"], "error gate command did not complete")
    if check_code:
        require(type(command["exit_code"]) is int and command["exit_code"] == code, "error gate command exit differs")
    if archive.platform in ("linux", "macos"):
        require(type(command["peak_process_memory_bytes"]) is int and command["peak_process_memory_bytes"] > 0,
                "error gate command omitted an available RSS measurement")
    return stdout, stderr


def error_tree(archive, report, full_path):
    spec = archive.member_from_work("selfhost-errors", report, full_path)
    outer, root = spec.split(":", 1)
    archive.open_tar(outer)
    members = archive.tars[outer].getmembers()
    roots = [member for member in members if member.name.rstrip("/") == root]
    require(len(roots) == 1 and roots[0].isdir(), "isolated I/O tree is missing or not a directory")
    tree = {}
    for member in members:
        if not member.name.startswith(root + "/"):
            continue
        name = member.name[len(root) + 1:].rstrip("/")
        require(name and name not in tree, "duplicate isolated I/O tree entry")
        require(member.isdir() or member.isfile(), "unexpected link/special file in isolated I/O tree")
        if member.isdir():
            tree[name] = None
        else:
            member_spec = outer + ":" + member.name
            archive.identity_of(member_spec)
            tree[name] = archive.read(member_spec).hex()
    return tree


def verify_error_runs(archive, report, rows, products, cases, oracle, *, sanitizers=False):
    cases_by_id = {case["id"]: case for case in cases}
    expected = {(producer, mode, name) for producer, mode in products for name in cases_by_id}
    actual = [(row["producer"], row["mode"], row["id"]) for row in rows]
    require(len(actual) == len(set(actual)) == len(expected) and set(actual) == expected,
            "standard-error product/scenario execution inventory differs")
    cwd_seen = set()
    overrides = ({"ASAN_OPTIONS": "detect_leaks=0:halt_on_error=1:abort_on_error=0",
                  "UBSAN_OPTIONS": "halt_on_error=1:print_stacktrace=1", "LC_ALL": "C"} if sanitizers else {})
    for row in rows:
        case = cases_by_id[row["id"]]
        binary = products[(row["producer"], row["mode"])]
        command = row["command"]
        require(row["expected"] == case["expected"] and row["environment"] == case["environment"]
                and command["environment"] == overrides, "I/O execution changed its frozen expectation/environment")
        require([norm(command["argv"][0]), *command["argv"][1:]] == [norm(binary["path"]), case["mode"], *case["args"]],
                "I/O scenario did not execute its actual product and frozen arguments")
        relative = (("sanitizers/" + row["producer"]) if sanitizers else (row["producer"] + "/" + row["mode"]))
        root = norm(report["work"]) + "/" + relative + "/" + case["id"]
        cwd = norm(command["cwd"])
        require(cwd == root + "/inputs" and cwd not in cwd_seen, "I/O scenario did not get a distinct fresh directory")
        cwd_seen.add(cwd)
        require(norm(command["stdout"]["path"]) == root + "/command/stdout.bin", "I/O raw command root differs")
        before = error_tree(archive, report, root + "/before")
        require(before == case["files"], "archived I/O input snapshot differs from frozen bytes")
        files = {item["relative"]: item for item in row["input_files"]}
        require(len(files) == len(row["input_files"]) and set(files) == set(case["files"]), "I/O input-file identity inventory differs")
        for name, data in case["files"].items():
            item = files[name]
            require(norm(item["path"]) == root + "/before/" + name
                    and item["kind"] == ("directory" if data is None else "file"), "I/O input snapshot identity has a wrong path/type")
            if data is not None:
                require(artifact_file(archive, "selfhost-errors", report, item) == bytes.fromhex(data),
                        "I/O input-file identity differs from frozen content")
        stdin = command["stdin"]
        if case.get("stdin_error", False):
            require(stdin == {"path": command["stdin"]["path"], "kind": "directory-read-error"}
                    and norm(stdin["path"]) == root + "/command/stdin-directory", "directory stdin failure fixture differs")
            require(error_tree(archive, report, stdin["path"]) == {}, "directory stdin fixture is not empty")
        else:
            require(norm(stdin["path"]) == root + "/command/stdin.bin"
                    and artifact_file(archive, "selfhost-errors", report, stdin) == bytes.fromhex(case["stdin_hex"]),
                    "I/O stdin bytes differ from frozen input")
        stdout, stderr = error_command(archive, report, command)
        after = error_tree(archive, report, cwd)
        require(after == row["files_after"], "I/O execution receipt differs from archived final files")
        checks = oracle.compare(oracle.evaluate(case), command["exit_code"], stdout, stderr, after)
        checks["completed"] = True
        require(row["checks"] == checks and all(checks.values()) and row["passed"] is True,
                "raw I/O bytes/files/exit differ from independent oracle: " + case["id"])
    return {"executions": len(actual), "raw_streams_verified": len(actual) * 2,
            "distinct_isolated_cwds": len(cwd_seen), "before_and_after_trees_verified": len(actual) * 2}

def recorded_expectation(oracle, case, directory, platform, mode):
    # Evaluate frozen byte expectations independently. Only recorded absolute
    # platform paths are substituted; the oracle never reads archived output.
    expected = oracle.evaluate(case) if mode == "json" else oracle.legacy(case)
    mappings = {}
    if case.get("input_mode") == "absolute":
        path_type = PureWindowsPath if platform == "windows" else PurePosixPath
        entry = str(path_type(directory) / case["input"])
        cut = max(entry.rfind("/"), entry.rfind("\\"))
        for item in case["files"]:
            path = item["path"]
            relative = str(PurePosixPath(path).relative_to(PurePosixPath(case["input"]).parent))
            rendered = entry if path == case["input"] else entry[:cut + 1] + relative
            mappings[oracle.display_path(case, path)] = rendered
    def replace(value):
        if isinstance(value, str):
            for old, new in sorted(mappings.items(), key=lambda pair: -len(pair[0])):
                value = value.replace(old, new)
            return value
        if isinstance(value, list):
            return [replace(item) for item in value]
        if isinstance(value, dict):
            return {key: replace(item) for key, item in value.items()}
        return value
    return replace(expected), replace(oracle.spelling(case))

        ("supplemental_case_count", "supplemental_passed", "supplemental_failed", len(supplement) * len(labels)),

    path_type = PureWindowsPath if platform == "windows" else PurePosixPath

    def archived_case_file(row, name, expected):
        full_path = str(path_type(row["command"]["cwd"]) / name)
        return artifact_file(archive, prefix, scope, {"path": full_path, **expected})
    for field, ids, mode in (("cases", set(wanted), "json"), ("text_cases", text_ids, "text"),
                            ("supplemental_cases", set(supplement), "legacy_cli")):
        rows = report[field]
        pairs = [(row["driver"], row["id"]) for row in rows]
        require(len(pairs) == len(set(pairs)) == len(ids) * len(labels)
                and set(pairs) == {(label, name) for label in labels for name in ids},
                "JSON/text/supplement per-compiler inventory differs")
        for row in rows:
            record = row["command"]
            label, name = row["driver"], row["id"]
            require(row["mode"] == mode and row["passed"] is True and row["failures"] == [],
                    "JSON/text/supplement case failed")
            require(record["argv"][0] == producers[label]["path"], "JSON command uses another executable")
            stdout = stream_bytes(archive, prefix, scope, record["stdout"])
            stderr = stream_bytes(archive, prefix, scope, record["stderr"])
            wanted_after = copy.deepcopy(row["files_before"])
            if mode == "legacy_cli":
                case = supplement[name]
                expected = case["expected"]
                source = ROOT / "selfhost/tests/diagnostics50/supplemental/main.yv"
                require(row["files_before"][case["input"]] ==
                        {"kind": "file", "bytes": source.stat().st_size, "sha256": digest(source)},
                        "legacy supplement materialized source differs")
                require(row["expected"] == expected and record["argv"][1:] == case["arguments"],
                        "legacy supplement expectation/arguments changed")
                require(passed_command(record, expected["exit"]) and stdout == b"", "legacy supplement status/stdout differs")
                require((b"usage:" in stderr and stderr.endswith(b"\n")) if expected["stderr"] == "usage"
                        else stderr == expected["stderr"].encode(), "legacy supplement stderr differs")
                if expected.get("output") == "frozen_c":
                    reference = (ROOT / "selfhost/tests/diagnostics50/supplemental/expected.c").read_bytes()
                    wanted_after[case["output"]] = {"kind": "file", "bytes": len(reference), "sha256": sha(reference)}
                    require(archived_case_file(row, case["output"], wanted_after[case["output"]]) == reference,
                            "legacy supplement generated C differs from frozen producer")
                command_id = label + "-legacy-" + name
            else:
                case = wanted[name]
                expected, spelling = recorded_expectation(oracle, case, record["cwd"], platform, mode)
                require(oracle.strict_equal(row["expected"], expected), "JSON/text expectation differs from frozen byte oracle")
                arguments = [spelling if arg == "@input" else arg for arg in case["arguments"]] if mode == "json" else ["check", spelling]
                require(record["argv"][1:] == arguments and passed_command(record, expected["exit"]),
                        "JSON/text command arguments or exit differ")
                if mode == "json":
                    require(not oracle.check_output(expected, stdout, stderr, record["exit_code"]),
                            "archived JSON bytes differ from independent oracle")
                else:
                    require(stdout == expected["stdout"].encode() and stderr == expected["stderr"].encode(),
                            "archived text bytes differ from frozen legacy output")
                snapshot = row["snapshot"]
                replacements = case.get("setup", {}).get("replacements", [])
                require(snapshot["applicable"] is bool(replacements) and snapshot["errors"] == [],
                        "snapshot barrier applicability/errors differ")
                mutations = []
                for change in replacements:
                    before = oracle.payload(case, change["path"])
                    after = change["text"].encode("utf-8")
                    mutations.append({"path": change["path"], "bytes_before": len(before), "sha256_before": sha(before),
                                      "bytes_after": len(after), "sha256_after": sha(after),
                                      "fifo_reader_connected_before_mutation": True})
                    wanted_after[change["path"]] = {"kind": "file", "bytes": len(after), "sha256": sha(after)}
                require(snapshot["mutations"] == mutations, "snapshot mutation bytes/ordering differ from frozen input")
                if replacements:
                    require(snapshot["reader_connected"] is True, "FIFO mutation happened without a compiler reader")
                    fifo = case["setup"]["fifo"]
                    raw = oracle.payload(case, fifo)
                    require(archived_case_file(row, fifo, {"bytes": len(raw), "sha256": sha(raw)}) == raw,
                            "FIFO was not archived as its frozen regular-file payload")
                    barriers.append({"driver": label, "id": name, "mode": mode, **snapshot})
                else:
                    require(snapshot["reader_connected"] is False, "unexpected FIFO reader outside snapshot case")
                for item in case["files"]:
                    if item["path"] != case.get("setup", {}).get("fifo"):
                        require(row["files_before"][item["path"]] ==
                                {"kind": "file", "bytes": item["bytes"], "sha256": item["sha256"]},
                                "materialized source before compiler execution differs")
                command_id = label + "-" + name + "-" + mode
            require(row["files_after"] == wanted_after, "JSON/text/supplement mutated undeclared files")
            for name, identity in row["files_after"].items():
                if identity["kind"] == "file":
                    archived_case_file(row, name, identity)
            expected_commands[command_id] = {"id": command_id, **record}
    commands = report["commands"]
    require(len(commands) == len(expected_commands)
            and {row["id"]: row for row in commands} == expected_commands, "JSON raw command inventory differs")
    expected_barriers = {(label, case["id"], mode) for label in labels for case in wanted.values()
                         if "fifo" in case.get("setup", {}) for mode in ("json", "text")}
    require(len(barriers) == len(expected_barriers)
            and {(row["driver"], row["id"], row["mode"]) for row in barriers} == expected_barriers,
            "JSON snapshot barrier inventory differs")
    return {"status": report["status"], "formal": report["formal"],
            "json_cli": {"passed": report["passed"], "total": report["case_count"], "failed": report["failed"]},
            "text": {"passed": report["text_passed"], "total": report["text_case_count"], "failed": report["text_failed"]},
            "supplemental": {"passed": report["supplemental_passed"], "total": report["supplemental_case_count"],
                             "failed": report["supplemental_failed"]},
            "commands": len(commands), "checks_passed": len(report["checks"]),
            "oracle_positive_control": controls["positive"], "oracle_negative_controls": negatives,
            "snapshot_barriers": barriers, "source_modules": source_modules,
            "producer_sha256": expected_compilers, "resources": report["resources"],
            "freeze": report["freeze"], "supplemental_freeze": report["supplemental_freeze"]}

            and detail["formal_frontend_acceptance"] is False and detail["candidate_status"] == "preliminary_passed"
            and detail["source_stage2_c"]["sha256"] == boot["stages"]["stage2_c"]["sha256"]
            and detail["instrumented_compiler"]["sha256"] == compiler["artifact"]["sha256"]
            and detail["executed_compiler"]["sha256"] == compiler["artifact"]["sha256"]
            and detail["sanitizer_environment"] == expected_environment, "compiler JSON instrumentation provenance differs")
    candidate = json.loads(artifact_file(archive, prefix, report, detail["receipt"]))
    require(passed_command(detail["command"])
            and stream_bytes(archive, prefix, report, detail["command"]["stderr"]) == b"",
            "instrumented JSON harness command failed")
    json_result = verify_diagnostics(archive, candidate, boot, "linux", bootstrap_hash,
                                     prefix=prefix, scope=report, candidate_sha=compiler["artifact"]["sha256"])
    require(detail["checks"] == candidate["checks"] and detail["total_commands"] == len(candidate["commands"]) == 186
            and detail["bound_inputs"] == len(candidate["input_identities"])
            and all(bound.get(path) == value for path, value in candidate["input_identities"].items()),
            "compiler JSON subreceipt is not bound into outer sanitizer evidence")
    require(detail["counts"] == {key: candidate[key] for key in
                                ("case_count", "passed", "failed", "text_case_count", "text_passed", "text_failed")}
            and detail["supplemental_counts"] == {key: candidate[key] for key in
                ("supplemental_applicable_per_driver", "supplemental_case_count", "supplemental_passed", "supplemental_failed")},
            "compiler JSON root/subreceipt count disagreement")
    require(detail["snapshot_barriers"] == [{key: value for key, value in row.items() if key != "driver"}
                                            for row in json_result["snapshot_barriers"]],
            "compiler JSON root/subreceipt snapshot disagreement")
    for record in candidate["commands"]:
        require(all(key not in record["environment"] or record["environment"][key] == value
                    for key, value in expected_environment.items()), "candidate command changed sanitizer environment")
    return {"status": report["status"], "programs": {"total": report["total"], "passed": report["passed"],
            "failed": report["failed"], "not_run": report["not_run"],
            "fixture_execution_isolation": {"cases": len(isolation_cases), "case_ids": sorted(isolation_cases),
                                            "distinct_isolated_cwds": len(isolated_paths), "raw_streams_verified": True}},
            "capability_controls": {name: {"passed": row["passed"], "exit_code": row["execution"]["exit_code"]}
                                    for name, row in controls.items()},
            "compiler": {"cases": compiler["case_total"], "passed": compiler["case_passed"],
                         "emissions": compiler["emission_total"], "emissions_passed": compiler["emission_passed"],
                         "stress": compiler["stress_total"], "stress_passed": compiler["stress_passed"],
                         "self_compilation_passed": compiler["self_compilation_passed"],
                         "stage2_c_sha256": boot["stages"]["stage2_c"]["sha256"], "artifact": compiler["artifact"],
                         "json_diagnostics": json_result},
            "source_modules": source_modules, "c_compiler": gcc, "flags": report["flags"],
            "sanitizer_environment": report["sanitizer_environment"], "limits": report["limits"]}


def summarize_one(directory, platform, head):
    output = {"platform": platform, "status": "checking"}
    archive = None
    phase = "artifact"
    try:
        archive = Archive(directory, platform, head)
        output["artifact"] = archive.identity
        native = archive.json("results.json", "results.json")
        phase = "native Rust suites"
        output["rust"] = verify_native(archive, native, head, platform)
        boot = archive.json("bootstrap-receipt.json", "selfhost/receipt.json")
        boot_hash = archive.verified["selfhost/receipt.json"]["sha256"]
        phase = "complete bootstrap"
        output["bootstrap"] = verify_bootstrap(archive, boot, native, platform)
        driver = archive.json("selfhost-driver-receipt.json", "selfhost-driver.tar.gz:selfhost-driver/receipt.json")
        phase = "ordinary driver"
        output["ordinary_driver"] = verify_driver(archive, driver, boot, platform, boot_hash)
        phase = "three-frontend SHA vectors"
        hashing = archive.json("selfhost-digest-receipt.json", "selfhost-digest.tar.gz:selfhost-digest/receipt.json")
        output["source_hashing"] = verify_digest(archive, hashing, boot, platform, boot_hash)
        phase = "formal structured diagnostics"
        diagnostics = archive.json("selfhost-diagnostics-receipt.json", "selfhost-diagnostics.tar.gz:selfhost-diagnostics/receipt.json")
        output["structured_diagnostics"] = verify_diagnostics(archive, diagnostics, boot, platform, boot_hash)
        phase = "formal standard-error six-product and independent I/O gate"
        errors = archive.json("selfhost-errors-receipt.json", "selfhost-errors.tar.gz:selfhost-errors/receipt.json")
        output["standard_errors"] = verify_errors(archive, errors, boot, platform, boot_hash)
        output["applications"] = {}
        for name in ("test-summary", "csv-check", "dep-index"):
            phase = name + " native application"
            app = archive.json(name + "-receipt.json", name + ".tar.gz:" + name + "/receipt.json")
            output["applications"][name] = verify_app(archive, app, name, platform, head, boot, boot_hash)
        if platform == "linux":
            phase = "required selfhost program/compiler sanitizer"
            report = archive.json("selfhost-sanitizers-receipt.json", "selfhost-sanitizers.tar.gz:selfhost-sanitizers/receipt.json")
            output["selfhost_sanitizers"] = verify_selfhost_sanitizers(archive, report, boot, head, boot_hash)
            phase = "required system sanitizer"
            report = archive.json("system-sanitize-receipt.json", "system-sanitize.tar.gz:system-sanitize/receipt.json")
            output["system_sanitizer"] = verify_system(report, boot, boot_hash)
        output["status"] = "passed"
    except Exception as error:
        output.update(status="failed", failed_phase=phase, error=type(error).__name__ + ": " + str(error))
    finally:
        if archive is not None:
            output["verified_receipts"] = {name: item for name, item in archive.verified.items()
                                           if name.endswith("receipt.json") or name == "results.json"}
            output["verified_member_count"] = len(archive.verified)
            archive.close()
    return output

def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    for name in ("linux", "macos", "windows"):
        parser.add_argument("--" + name, type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--head", "--expected-head", dest="head", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--run-id", "--expected-run", dest="run_id", type=int, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, default=Path(__file__).with_name("ci-receipts-summary.json"))
    args = parser.parse_args()
    require(re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{40}", args.head), "expected head must be a full lowercase commit SHA")
    current = subprocess.run(["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], cwd=ROOT, stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
                             stderr=subprocess.PIPE, text=True, timeout=15)
    require(current.returncode == 0 and current.stdout.strip() == args.head,
            "checkout HEAD must equal the selected CI implementation head")
    summary = {
        "schema": "yavo-batch51-ci-actual-receipts/1", "status": "checking",
        "head": args.head, "run_id": args.run_id, "network_requests": 0,
        "scope": "Downloaded GitHub ZIP digest/size, nested receipts and artifact bytes; current source identities; native full versus selected scopes",
        "source_head_verified": current.stdout.strip(),
        "compiler_module_inventory": sorted(COMPILER_PARTS),
        "current_sources": {name: current_identity(name) for name in source_inventory()},
        "platforms": {},
    }
    for name in ("linux", "macos", "windows"):
        summary["platforms"][name] = summarize_one(getattr(args, name), name, args.head)
        item = summary["platforms"][name]
        print(json.dumps({"platform": name, "status": item["status"],
                          "failed_phase": item.get("failed_phase"), "error": item.get("error")}, ensure_ascii=False),
              file=sys.stderr, flush=True)
    artifacts = [row.get("artifact", {}) for row in summary["platforms"].values()]
    runs = {row.get("run_id") for row in artifacts}
    ids = {row.get("id") for row in artifacts}
    same_run = len(runs) == 1 and None not in runs
    unique_artifacts = len(ids) == 3 and None not in ids
    expected_run = runs == {args.run_id}
    summary["shared_run_verified"] = same_run and expected_run
    summary["distinct_platform_artifacts_verified"] = unique_artifacts
    if same_run:
        summary["observed_run_id"] = next(iter(runs))
    summary["status"] = ("passed" if same_run and unique_artifacts and expected_run
                         and all(row["status"] == "passed" for row in summary["platforms"].values()) else "failed")
    args.output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    args.output.write_text(json.dumps(summary, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    print(json.dumps(summary, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, sort_keys=True))
    return 0 if summary["status"] == "passed" else 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
